name: mise-docs
description: Standalone PHP documentation consumer for the MISE package family.

scripts.build: npm run build:dependencies && npm run build:client && node scripts/Build.mjs
scripts.build:dependencies: npm run build --workspace mise-webgl && npm run build --workspace mise-php && npm run build --workspace mise-ui
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run build:static
scripts.test: node --test tests/Compiler.test.mjs tests/PromptCompiler.test.mjs && npm run build && node --test tests/Artifact.test.mjs
